title: What Turns the Moon Blood‑Red During a Partial Eclipse?

scenes.text: Tonight’s partial eclipse will paint the Moon a deep crimson over Spain
scenes.query: partial lunar eclipse Spain red moon

scenes.text: The red color comes from Earth’s atmosphere filtering sunlight, a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering
scenes.label: RAYLEIGH SCATTERING

scenes.text: During a partial eclipse only a slice of the Moon enters Earth’s umbra, creating a dramatic gradient
scenes.label: PARTIAL UMBRA SHADE

scenes.text: The next total eclipse won’t happen until August 2027, making tonight’s view a rare treat
scenes.label: NEXT TOTAL 2027

scenes.text: Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: Discover why the Moon glows scarlet during a partial eclipse and why this night’s spectacle is unique. Follow for daily science!
